statement: The proportion of SUID cases where mothers did not use birth control has changed since 2016.
rationale: This study compares proportions among SUID cases across periods using a case series and population reference, but cannot estimate incidence or establish causation due to the lack of a denominator source.
prior_art: SUID_manuscript_v9_clean.C10 and bedsharing_ms_v7.C18 discuss data quality issues in vital records and sleep-environment classification, respectively. These do not address trends in birth control usage among SUID cases, leaving this question open.
cannot_establish: This design cannot establish causation or estimate incidence rates due to the lack of a denominator source.
